resolved_findings.problem: fx*tau/z circular footprint can omit real supporting pixel rays at ordinary off-axis geometry.
resolved_findings.counterexample: X=1.2,Z=2,fx=fy=500,cx=320,tau=.025: u=627 intersects the uncertainty ball but the old radius6.25 aroundu620 excludes it.
resolved_findings.resolution: Sphere tangent bounds plus actual forward ray/sphere intersection; independent intrinsics; bounded image enumeration and genuine outside-ray witnesses.

resolved_findings.problem: Free-space vote ignored the authorized local-band exception and used centre radial q for all footprint rays.
resolved_findings.counterexample: r=2,q=1.97,tau=.025,T=.04,lambda=1.5 is in the legal local band but old F check suppressed it.
resolved_findings.resolution: Per-ray qtilde=Z||w||,delta=r-qtilde and full Eq8 authorization, plus endpoint beyond the ray-specific far sphere intersection.

resolved_findings.problem: Independent history/fill hypotheses for the same triangle can reject history but resurrect its online copy with reset source error.
resolved_findings.counterexample: Historical face2.10m,epsilon=.08,h=.025; identical fill h=.01,epsilon0; currentP2.00m,s0; three broad R views and one sparse S view. History exits, fill formerly survived as O+S.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact shared-key quotient before voting; eligible history uniquely owns p/h/epsilon/source face; output uses same key.

resolved_findings.problem: Unconditional one-voxel coincidence veto neutralized valid R without transferring representation to P.
resolved_findings.counterexample: Old wall2.04m,h=.025,epsilon=.03,current wall2m,s0: distance<=2h masked all R and retained two nonidentical surfaces.
resolved_findings.resolution: Removed coincidence field, separate nearest-distance computation and 2h veto.

resolved_findings.problem: Filtering only each triangle unconstrained closest point is not continuous constrained surface search.
resolved_findings.counterexample: Nearest point projects to a one-pixel identity hole while a nearby point on the same face has valid same-identity support.
resolved_findings.resolution: R predicts the actual centre pixel using firstHit of all P; no per-ID nearest grids or accept queries remain in SessionRefusion.

resolved_findings.problem: The first 14b implementation collected attributes only from unintegrated-domain fill candidates.
resolved_findings.counterexample: A 5cm background online/history triangle has updated online colour/time. The 2cm PresentTsdf fully integrates its centroid cube and produces different triangulation. The historical triangle is supported and retained, but the online face is not a fill candidate, so its fresh attributes were lost.
resolved_findings.normal_production_impact: Output metadata/appearance error on ordinary multi-resolution planar surfaces; does not stop execution.
resolved_findings.resolution: Main thread changed attribute collection to ALL online faces while requiring the same exact oriented key and authorized historical owner.

resolved_findings.problem: Historical geometry source priority previously discarded a newer same-key online appearance/time.
resolved_findings.resolution: 14b now chooses the newest recorded appearance, current-source and lower-index ties, maximum latest stamp, and minimum positive first stamp without altering p/epsilon. Missing attribute arrays retain available source values; P retains 9a ownership.

remaining_obligations.description: Same-ID co-oriented close foreground and source-position correction can produce identical observations. A wall2.04m behind a new same-ID panel2m passes the R window withh=.025,epsilon=.03. The accepted local-single-layer model interprets this as one visible branch; it is not a universal physical same-surface proof.

production_call_chain.contract: Input and time preflight call the actual player read_frames before output creation.
Strictly increasing input stamps; constant session time translation; publish each selected input once and wait for its ACK without retransmitting.
A shared session-local archive is attached to native active window and backend only when final refusion is enabled.
spinOnce offers after motion/object/tracking processing and before updateMap/ACK sinks. Terminal duplicate-stamp output does not call archive.offer.
Terminal refusion releases archive once, checks nonempty, supplies frames/scales/current authorization and explicit predecessor, and publishes only a completed result.

immutable_timestamp_review.result: No normal-production blocker located in the current producer/consumer path.
immutable_timestamp_review.offer_contract: same timestamp+same pose+same encoded range/physical IDs is idempotent; changed payload throws. Compression is deterministic for the canonical offer producer in one process.
immutable_timestamp_review.terminal_duplicate: finishMapping repeats the latest downstream sensor stamp for reconciliation but does not re-offer the frame archive, so revised terminal output does not conflict with the immutable archive.
immutable_timestamp_review.release_contract: After last input ACK, all normal archive offers have completed; release sorts unique timestamps and clears the live timestamp index. Normal release output satisfies diagnostic load strict order.
immutable_timestamp_review.public_api_scope: Archive immutability applies to encoded geometry observations, not RGB content (which the archive does not store). Public release/offer concurrency and arbitrary manually constructed diagnostic frames are not the normal terminal call protocol.
immutable_timestamp_review.normal_masks: Archive is offered before native map integration and excludes semantic dynamic/invalid labels plus motion/dynamic pixels, while keeping raw physical IDs for later bilateral identity checks.

integration_first_hit_consistency.equation8: PresentTsdf uses delta=(depth_z-Z)*ray_norm=r-Z||w||, requiresdelta>-T and fordelta>T enforcesZ||w||<lambda-T. Surface F uses the same projective authorization per actual footprint ray, including the local-band exception.
integration_first_hit_consistency.equation9: Each valid authorized update uses min(1,delta/T), equal weight1; extractMesh requires eight positive corner weights, fixed zero isosurface interpolation and deterministic unit order.
integration_first_hit_consistency.current_pixel: Refusion R constructs the unit world ray from the actual rounded centre pixel and queries ALL P before any identity/orientation acceptance; raw measurement ID and predicted face ID must both match.
integration_first_hit_consistency.first_hit: Nearest positive two-sided intersection; exact distance ties choose smaller original face index, including cell-boundary ties. No per-ID search through foreground geometry remains.
integration_first_hit_consistency.result: No additional normal-parameter behavior counterexample located beyond the already recorded local-single-layer identifiability boundary. Fixed sparse-unit/stride allocation remains the declared numerical integration protocol.

Missing source attribute arrays do not erase an available attribute; timestamps are separately merged.
P geometry retains assembly priority and its assigned-face observation times from9a.
